subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Switching: Transistors as Digital Gates
description: A short lesson to help you apply Switching: Transistors as Digital Gates.

hook.text: A transistor that's fully on or fully off becomes a digital switch: 1 or 0.

buildup.text: Logic gates combine transistors: AND, OR, NOT — the building blocks of digital circuits.

discovery.text: An inverter uses just one NMOS and one PMOS transistor. Two transistors, one logic function.

twist.text: From these simple gates you can build adders, memory, and entire processors.

climax.text: A modern CPU performs billions of AND, OR, NOT operations every second.

punchline.text: On or off, 1 or 0 — the transistor is the smallest decision maker.

quiz.question: How many transistors does a basic CMOS inverter use?
options: Two — one NMOS and one PMOS transistor
Four — two NMOS and two PMOS transistors
